relations.text: 年次報告は、Google CloudをAWSとともにハイパースケーラーの提携エコシステムに挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report lists Google Cloud, with AWS, in its partner ecosystem of hyperscalers and cloud providers

source.label: GitLab 10-K
source.quote: We have been investing in our global partner ecosystem, composed of hyperscalers and cloud providers, including Google Cloud and AWS, technology and independent software vendor partners, global resellers, and system integrators.

relations.text: Google Cloudと協業し、Vertex AIでGitLab Duo Agent Platformを動かせるようにする
relations.text_en: Announced a collaboration with Google Cloud so joint customers can power GitLab Duo Agent Platform with Vertex AI

source.label: GitLab 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Announced collaborations with AWS and Google Cloud to bring agentic DevSecOps to enterprise teams, enabling joint customers to power GitLab Duo Agent Platform with Amazon Bedrock or Vertex AI using the models, governance, and cloud commitments they already have in place.

relations.text: 年次報告は、AWSをGoogle Cloudとともにハイパースケーラーの提携エコシステムに挙げている

source.quote: We have been investing in our global partner ecosystem, composed of hyperscalers and cloud providers, including Google Cloud and AWS, technology and independent software vendor partners, global resellers, and system integrators.

relations.text: AWSと協業し、Amazon BedrockでGitLab Duo Agent Platformを動かせるようにする
relations.text_en: Announced a collaboration with AWS so joint customers can power GitLab Duo Agent Platform with Amazon Bedrock

source.label: GitLab 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Announced collaborations with AWS and Google Cloud to bring agentic DevSecOps to enterprise teams, enabling joint customers to power GitLab Duo Agent Platform with Amazon Bedrock or Vertex AI using the models, governance, and cloud commitments they already have in place.

relations.text: Anthropicのモデル「Claude」との統合を深め、GitLabの統制の枠内で最新機能を使えるようにした
relations.text_en: Deepened integration with Anthropic's Claude models, giving customers access to the latest Claude capabilities within GitLab's governance framework

source.label: GitLab 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Deepened integration with Anthropic’s Claude models, giving GitLab customers access to the latest Claude capabilities within the same governance, compliance, and audit framework that governs every other action in GitLab.

relations.text: プラットフォームがAnthropicのClaude Codeなどと連携する
relations.text_en: The platform integrates with Anthropic Claude Code, among other AI agents

source.label: GitLab 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: The platform integrates with Anthropic Claude Code, Cursor, Amazon Q, Google Gemini CLI, and opencode, enabling developers to collaborate with AI agents that autonomously handle complex development tasks using rich project context for more intelligent AI outcomes.

relations.text: OpenAI Codexなど外部エージェントとの統合を提供した
relations.text_en: Delivered integrations with external agents including OpenAI Codex

source.label: GitLab 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Expanded GitLab Duo Agent Platform with purpose-built AI agents, launched the AI Catalog for custom agent creation, and delivered integrations with external agents such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex and Google Gemini.

relations.text: ギットラボの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in ギットラボ’s annual report

source.label: GitLab 10-K
source.quote: Our principal competitor is Microsoft Corporation, which owns GitHub.

relations.text: ギットラボの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in GitLab’s annual report

source.label: GitLab 10-K
source.quote: We also compete with DevOps product collections and point solutions from vendors such as Atlassian, JFrog, and Harness.

relations.text: ジェイフロッグの年次報告が、ギットラボを競合として挙げている

source.label: JFrog 10-K
source.quote: Many companies address only certain parts of the DevOps cycle and may compete with a limited set of JFrog offerings, including Microsoft’s GitHub, GitLab, Cloudsmith, and Sonatype.
